**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Ampeg SVT is.
2. Learn how its circuit makes its sound.

4. Listen to famous tracks.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **SVT** ("Super Vacuum Tube") was designed by **Bill Hughes and Roger Cox** and shown in **1969**: **300 watts** from a 14-valve design, when most valve amps gave under 100 (Wikipedia, "Ampeg SVT").
- Prototypes carried the **Rolling Stones' 1969 US tour**, for every guitar and bass (Wikipedia).
- Ampeg recommended **two 8x10 cabinets**; output valves 6146B at first, then 6550 from mid-1970 (Wikipedia).

## How it makes its sound

- Big power means headroom: the SVT stays clean on bass until pushed, then growls.
- Its tone section is not the Fender stack: here Bass and Treble are shelves, **Midrange** a peak or dip at one of five frequencies, and **Ultra Lo** / **Ultra Hi** switches add deep lows or top. These controls and values are from general knowledge: unverified.
- The **8x10** cabinet: eight small speakers, a sealed box, little top.

## The amp

The Ampeg SVT's control panel, drawn after photos (positions approximate, no logos). Drag a knob (or use the arrow keys), click a switch, then press a ▶ button. The bass is this site's pickup model; **Pedals in front** puts one of the site's pedal models before the amp. Nobody has compared the sound with a real amp. The graph shows the tone controls and the cabinet (the valves' distortion is left out of it).

## Guided tour

```{=html}
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="svt" data-set="{&quot;volume&quot;:4}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Volume 4.</b> Clean, round bass.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="svt" data-set="{&quot;volume&quot;:4,&quot;ultralo&quot;:true}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Ultra Lo on.</b> Deeper lows, scooped mids.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="svt" data-set="{&quot;volume&quot;:4,&quot;middle&quot;:9,&quot;midf&quot;:&quot;800&quot;}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Midrange up at 800 Hz.</b> Punch that cuts through a band.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="svt" data-set="{&quot;volume&quot;:4,&quot;ultrahi&quot;:true,&quot;treble&quot;:7}" data-play="pluck"><p><b>Ultra Hi.</b> Fingers and string click.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="svt" data-set="{&quot;volume&quot;:9}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Volume 9.</b> The famous growl.</p></div>
```
